description: This file defines a plugin class for the TestLink open source test management system. The TLTestPlugin class extends a base class and registers itself with various UI hooks and event handlers related to test suite, project, test case, requirement, and test run management. It provides methods for plugin configuration, event handling callbacks, and UI link generation.

classes.name: TLTestPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class for TestLink that registers event hooks, UI links, and handles test management events.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Initializes plugin metadata such as name, description, version, author, contact, and URL.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Returns plugin configuration options as an array.

methods.name: hooks
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event names to handler method names.

methods.name: testsuite_create
methods.description: Handles the test suite creation event, logs a message.

methods.name: testproject_create
methods.description: Handles test project creation, logs details.

methods.name: testproject_update
methods.description: Handles test project update, logs details.

methods.name: testcase_update
methods.description: Handles test case update, logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_create
methods.description: Handles creation of test requirements, logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_update
methods.description: Handles update of test requirements, logs details.

methods.name: testrequirement_delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of test requirements, logs details.

methods.name: testExecute
methods.description: Handles execution of a test run, logs details.

methods.name: testrun_display_block
methods.description: Returns an HTML snippet to display a test run block.

methods.name: bottom_link
methods.description: Returns a label and href for the bottom left menu link.

methods.name: top_link
methods.description: Returns a label and href for the top left menu link.

methods.name: right_top_link
methods.description: Returns a label and href for the top right menu link.

methods.name: right_bottom_link
methods.description: Returns a label and href for the bottom right menu link.
